=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text tq "\""
text tyes "\" numeric\n"
text tno "\" not numeric\n"
text s0 "0"
text s1 "-12"
text s2 "3.14"
text s3 "+1e5"
text s4 "1e-3"
text s5 ".5"
text s6 "5."
text s7 "abc"
text s9 "12a"
text s10 "-"
text s11 "1.2.3"
text s12 "e5"
text s13 "1e"
text s14 "--1"
text s15 "6.02E+23"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note digits returns the offset after a run of decimal digits starting at i
fn digits a view uchar * i ulong to ulong
j = i
while lt j len a bound 4096
c = get a j
if or lt c 48 gt c 57
ret j
end
j = add j 1
end
ret j
end
note sign returns the offset after an optional + or - at i
fn sign a view uchar * i ulong to ulong
if lt i len a
c = get a i
if or eq c 43 eq c 45
ret add i 1
end
end
ret i
end
note numeric accepts [+-] then digits with an optional fraction (at least one digit in all), then an
note optional exponent e or E, [+-], at least one digit; nothing else, no spaces
fn numeric a view uchar * to bool
i = sign a 0
j = digits a i
m = sub j i
if lt j len a
if eq get a j 46
i = add j 1
j = digits a i
m = add m sub j i
end
end
if eq m 0
ret false
end
if lt j len a
c = get a j
if or eq c 101 eq c 69
i = sign a add j 1
j = digits a i
if eq j i
ret false
end
end
end
ret eq j len a
end
fn show a view uchar * to void
emit tq
emit a
if numeric a
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
end
fn main to int
show s0
show s1
show s2
show s3
show s4
show s5
show s6
show s7
note the empty string: an empty text literal would read as unsized at this pin, so slice one
show part s7 0 0
show s9
show s10
show s11
show s12
show s13
show s14
show s15
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>

"abc" not numeric

"1.2.3" not numeric

"6.02E+23" numeric
</pre>
